_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2025 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical industry.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is in scope for a chemicals company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names chemicals, and the FY2025 10-K names no cloud, offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles, crypto, or GLP-1 drugs; ENERGY_TRANSITION, scoped to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', leaves the watch list with the FY2025 10-K: 'Accordingly, our refining business, previously disclosed as the Refining segment, is reported as a discontinued operation.', and its risk factors no longer say that demand for the products it makes may be reduced), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule); the FY2025 10-K names generative AI only in its data privacy and security risk factor ('In addition, the complex and dynamic regulatory environment surrounding artificial intelligence (“AI”), including generative AI, subjects us to a variety of risks.'), not as a substitute for the products LyondellBasell makes; EV's 'auto parts suppliers' and 'fuel retail' name no LyondellBasell business: its 10-Ks say its products go into 'automotive components' among many uses, and its refining business is a discontinued operation

ENERGY_TRANSITION, scoped to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', leaves the watch list with the FY2025 10-K: 'Accordingly, our refining business, previously disclosed as the Refining segment, is reported as a discontinued operation.', and its risk factors no longer say that demand for the products it makes may be reduced), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule); the FY2025 10-K names generative AI only in its data privacy and security risk factor ('In addition, the complex and dynamic regulatory environment surrounding artificial intelligence (“AI”), including generative AI, subjects us to a variety of risks.'), not as a substitute for the products LyondellBasell makes; EV's 'auto parts suppliers' and 'fuel retail' name no LyondellBasell business: its 10-Ks say its products go into 'automotive components' among many uses, and its refining business is a discontinued operation. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.30x; +107% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.30; conservative 2yr -0%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.7%/yr (worst year FY16-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +22.8%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY25 median

BULL.desc: EPS +22.8%/yr (FY16-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +66.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2026-08-28) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.30x (90.6% downside to Bear $6 / +69.6% upside to Bull $108) | Adj composite 2.61 vs market 2.31: gap +0.30 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +107% above the EPP floor $31 (7x FY26E $4.39) | Conservative 2-yr case: -0.5% total (-0.3%/yr) | At 14.5x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $84 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; O&P–Americas +606.3% and Intermediates & Derivatives +77.5% operating income in Q2 2026, forward revenues +19.8% (no FY26 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2026 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
